question: Determine whether noncommutative PIT or blow-up rank gives a legal route to commutative PIT, with exact field, model, dimension, cost, and a scoped counterexample.
result: A proved fixed-order ROABP-to-NC-ABP PIT bridge and an exact same-path / blow-up-rank obstruction for unrestricted ABP transfers.
unresolved: No identity-preserving lift for unrestricted commutative ABPs or circuits was found.
No lower bound or general commutative PIT resolution is claimed.
